steps.message: In Simple Gallery Pro, copy receipt_strong_dog_N9C9.jpg in DCIM and save a copy with the same name in Download

Execute: adb shell "ls -l /sdcard/DCIM/receipt_strong_dog_N9C9.jpg 2>/dev/null; ls -ld /sdcard/Download 2>/dev/null; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/DCIM/receipt_strong_dog_N9C9.jpg 2>/dev/null; ls -ld /storage/emulated/0/Download 2>/dev/null; pm list packages | grep -i simplemobiletools.gallery"
